correctness.rationale: The 2021 known gap characterization (a_i≤3, at most one a_i=3 and no adjacent long gaps) is correctly credited. Deleting a selected vertex merges two consecutive gaps into a+b+1; negating the known feasibility criterion produces exactly the given t=0/t=1 four-gap predicates. Tracking the last three gaps gives 27-state or 64-state directed transfers; -u∂_u logdet(I-T) converts rooted words to labelled sets via factor n/k, and coefficient y selects one 3-gap. For every cyclic valid word the supplied 64-vertex integer potential satisfies h(next)≤h(current)+4q−3 on all 136 allowed edges, whence 0≤4n−7k. The explicit (3,0,1,0,2,(0,1,0,2)^m,1) words have (n,k)=(13+7m,6+4m), attaining limsup 4/7. Independent direct graph-neighborhood oracle matched the gap criterion for every subset in n=7..14 (32,640 subsets); independent 136-edge cycle-feasible potential computation and witness checks support but do not replace the general proof.
